strategies.label: Index · smart money (FII/DII)
strategies.note: Follows DII futures, FII options and the opposite of retail positions (NSE participant data). Buys ATM when the combined score is in its top / bottom 20% of 60 days.

strategies.label: Index · 20-day breakout (1:2)
strategies.note: Close above the highest high of the last 20 days → CE (below the lowest low → PE). 1 strike in the money. Stop −35%, target +70% (1:2).

strategies.label: Index · EMA 9/21 cross (1:2)
strategies.note: EMA 9 crosses EMA 21 in the direction of EMA 50. 1 strike in the money. Stop −25%, target +50% (1:2), max 3 days.

strategies.label: Stocks · smart money (FII/DII)
strategies.note: Same market-wide smart-money score, applied to the 20 large F&O stocks (monthly options). Skipped when India VIX is in the top 20% of its last 60 days (options too expensive): PF 1.51 → 1.99 in 2025–26.

strategies.label: Index · OI-extreme (your 30:70 idea)
strategies.note: Call:put OI within ±2% of the price at a 60-day extreme → buy the side with less OI. Works with these exact settings but is sensitive to them: shown, not used in the combined accounts.

accounts.label: All buying signals · ₹20k (spreads)
accounts.note: Recommended start. Up to 2 positions of ≈ ₹7k. Index signals as debit spreads (buy ATM, sell 6 strikes out), stock signals as 1 option. Started-any-month test: 74% of 12-month runs ended in profit.

accounts.label: All buying signals · ₹50k
accounts.note: Same signals as plain option buys (≈ ₹15–20k each, up to 2 at once). Higher reward: 2025–26 win 48%, PF 2.4; 87% of 12-month runs ended in profit.
